learning.assumptions: One admissible instantiation. Optional losses require matching data and assumptions.

belief.title: Belief update
belief.explanation: Assimilates newly released information and handles late arrivals.
belief.assumptions: Replay or an out-of-sequence update is needed for late records.

support.title: Action eligibility
support.explanation: Gates use of an action-conditioned rollout on support for that action in scope.
variables: support: action, population and history match.
support.assumptions: Support is an operational check distinct from causal identification.

transition.title: Illustrative hybrid transition
transition.explanation: Combines mechanistic and learned dynamics, then constrains the complete stochastic draw.
transition.assumptions: Requires physical coordinates and a justified projection set.

bound.title: Conditional rollout error bound
bound.latex:
e_{k+1}\le L_k e_k+\epsilon_k,\qquad
e_h\le e_0\prod_{k=0}^{h-1} L_k
+\sum_{j=0}^{h-1}\epsilon_j\prod_{k=j+1}^{h-1}L_k .
bound.explanation: Quantifies how initial error and per-step discrepancies can propagate.
bound.assumptions: Shared inputs and a declared envelope containing both trajectories.

horizon.title: Forecast horizon eligibility
horizon.explanation: Allows substantive forecasts only at supported horizons.
variables: H_eval(q): evaluated set for query q.
horizon.assumptions: Evaluation must match the release, endpoint, mode and population.

effect.title: Sequential g-computation
effect.explanation: Integrates outcome expectations under a specified regime.
effect.assumptions: Requires consistency, exchangeability, positivity and appropriate follow-up handling.

effect-gate.title: Effect label gate
effect-gate.explanation: Requires an identification certificate in the claimed scope.
effect-gate.assumptions: A certificate must address the exact estimand, intervention and population.

objective.title: Planning objective
objective.explanation: Balances modeled cost and epistemic uncertainty over eligible regimes.
objective.assumptions: Search may be approximate. Eligible candidates still require guard checks.

guard.title: Proposal guard
guard.latex: \mathrm{Guard}(\tilde g,\mathcal H_t)=\begin{cases}\textsf{allow-to-present}, & \forall j:G_j\le0\ \wedge\ U^{ep}\le u_{max}\ \wedge\ \mathrm{OOD}=0\ \wedge\ h\le h^\*\\ \textsf{revise}, & \text{a constraint is violated and an alternative exists (edge "Alternatives")}\\ \textsf{abstain}/\textsf{escalate}, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
guard.explanation: Allows presentation, requests revision, or abstains or escalates.
guard.assumptions: Use the scoped rollout eligibility policy in P5 and the separate dispatch check.

risk.title: Trajectory risk constraint
risk.explanation: Bounds violation probability across the declared plausible trajectory laws.
risk.assumptions: The plausible law set and risk budget need explicit justification.

fresh.title: Freshness
fresh.explanation: Checks the snapshot bound to the published result.
variables: bound snapshot: release cutoff and evidence revision.
fresh.assumptions: Material changes can invalidate a pending result.

approval.title: Authorization invariant
approval.explanation: Commits dispatch only with a matching current approval consumed once.
approval.assumptions: Requires stable binding, atomic consumption and durable records.

audit.title: Durable trace invariant
audit.explanation: Requires a durable trace for every governed committed hand-off.
audit.assumptions: Correctness depends on the commit and audit boundary.

provenance.title: Observed-record boundary
provenance.explanation: Requires observed provenance for measured-field writes.
provenance.assumptions: Simulation can be stored on a distinct provenance channel.

drift.title: Monitoring statistic
drift.explanation: Compares forecast miscoverage to its nominal level using eligible matched outcomes.
drift.assumptions: An unexecuted alternative has no factual outcome for this comparison.

fallback.title: Drift response
fallback.explanation: Inhibits affected dispatch immediately and applies the fallback within the deadline.
fallback.assumptions: Requires independent clock progress and functioning inhibition.

release.title: Release validity
release.explanation: Requires a pinned and currently valid release for substantive publication.
release.assumptions: Restrictions may still be communicated when publication is blocked.
